markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set [F1]; second model and all five neighbors agree.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu <1% | Dominant single class |
| Conformal set | Invasive only (α=0.1) | Unambiguous |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.999 / percentile 1.0 | Not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive [F5] | Unanimous neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 3, 8) · ↑ invasive · Score above typical; strongest association [F2] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Low score; scarce glands fit invasive [F4] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 1) · ↑ invasive · Low score; little benign tissue · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 8, 9, 11) · ↑ invasive · High score in these regions · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Difference from random is 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007), so not shown to reflect the classifier. Leans on Frequent mitotic figures (0/20 spot check): Unreliable [F3].

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated stain degradation (severity 3) distorts features; reliability AUROC only 0.69 on a small test set.
- Margin call (tumor at all four margins) [F7] is simulated frozen-section output; verify edges directly.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 3, 8**: confirm tumor cells infiltrating stroma.
2. **Regions 0, 2, 11**: count mitoses yourself; the concept failed its spot check.
3. **Region 7**: look for true glands, where the tubule score peaks.
